reviews.text: My dog had an excellent full groom here and we’ll be coming back. Great cut and he appeared to gave a wonderful time. He can be quite reactive but the team really took care of him and went at his pace.

Just got home from Groomer London and it’s a big thumbs all round. Our Pomeranian, Tank, looks and feels great! We had the pleasure of being looked after by Diana who really took her time explaining what she thinks would be best but also allowed for me to voice any questions I might have had. You get the impression that they really care. Will definitely be back 👍
They are the expert!
Our toy Pomeranian always comes away very happy and looking fantastic.  Highly recommended.

It’s the only place my double coated German spitz will go and the only place that knows what to do with a double coated dog. My dog had been traumatized by other dog groomers in Kensington but although still not a favorite hobby she really doesn’t mind too much. Plus the only place that is at ground floor level with everything on show so you can see what’s happening to the dogs. Would not go anywhere else and I always recommend.

It was Sid’s first ever time and he was made very welcome! The team did a superb job and fed back how it went. Sid came out looking and smelling very clean, it was a shame we had to walk home in the rain!
No doubt the best haircut our dog Chickpea has ever had, so glad we found this place. We will be back for sure. Huge thank you 🌼🌼.

What a relief to find Groomer. Tania looked after Tweedledum beautifully she was so gentle with him and he took to her immediately.  He was beautifully groomed, many tangles taken out of him, his fur cut just to the right length and he came out looking gorgeous, relaxed and smelling divine.  Thank you Tania!

I’ve been a client of Lilo’s grooming salon for nearly 2 years now, and I can honestly say the experience has always been amazing. Every single visit, I find the same level of care, attention, kindness, professionalism, and excellent service.

The grooming is always perfect, even down to the smallest details I request. What I appreciate the most is that, like in every company, some groomers may leave and new ones arrive, but as a client, you never feel any difference in quality. Every new groomer who joins is incredibly skilled and able to follow the client’s exact requests, always delivering the same perfect result as the previous colleague.

You can truly feel the passion and love they have for their work and for every little dog that comes through their door.

Me and especially Lilo are always so happy to come back. In fact, whenever we walk nearby Lilo stops right in front of the door trying to go inside! Honestly, what better confirmation could you ask for? ❤️
They were amazing with our puppy! Highly recommend

Today was the second time that we brought our female chow to a puppy grooming session at Groomer London. I cannot recommend enough, my partner and I are over the moon with her treatment. The staff is friendly, professional and they clearly enjoy looking after the dogs ♥️🐾

Our girly is stubborn but she was happy (wagging her tail and all!) to come back and remembered familiar faces after 2 months. She smells divine, her coat is shiny and she looks gorgeous.
We will be back for regular grooming sessions! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We took our dog along for a hair cut and were absolutely delighted at the result. Our dog who is usually nervous in the groomers was happy and calm. He looks great now - long may it last. Definitely recommend.
Miroslav did another fantastic job of hand stripping GATSBY our 3 year old  Griffon.He looks divine and highly recommend
Always lovely service
Amazing service!

Fantastic service! My Golden Retriever was happy when I picked him up and looked incredibly handsome. I especially loved that he stayed upstairs with a view into the shop the whole time. He’s very scared of groomers, particularly those in basements, so this made all the difference. Highly recommended!

I had such a wonderful experience with Diana. She was incredibly meticulous and attentive, taking great care throughout the grooming process and paying attention to every little detail. She was also so kind and patient, making the whole experience relaxed and enjoyable.
It's clear that Diana genuinely cares about both her clients and their pets, and her professionalism really shines through. She is a real asset to an already excellent establishment, and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend her. Thank you, Diana, for your outstanding care!
Cliffy always walks out looking like a total superstar! Hands down the best groomer!
Great service. Thanks you!
Very good place. My puppy came back beautiful and I loved that you can see what’s happening. I will cone back each month. Thank you!
Superb service, very attentive groomer, caring staff. An altogether excellent experience.

Brought my Border Collie in for grooming and a haircut, and I was really impressed. Not only did they do a great job, but they were also very professional. I decided I wanted his fur cut a bit shorter, and the team accommodated my request straight away and got everything done quickly and efficiently. Excellent customer service and professionalism. I will definitely be bringing my dog back for grooming in the future!

Do NOT go to this place. Our dog had an appointment at 10am. We arrived at 9:45 to a very startled and overwhelmed groomer with 3 dogs already inside the grooming area. I am certain there was a scheduling mistake but I really needed my dog groomed as we will be flying later tonight. I had expected 1-1,5 hours max for a “keep it up” grooming and had intended to wait in a cafe. I was informed it would be around 2 or 3pm when I should collect our dog. No groomer takes 4-5 hours for a tidy up of eyes, paws and private area! They claimed the phone number on file was wrong and they couldn’t reach me. Let’s pretend that’s not a lie. I asked what time was she ready. “1 hour ago”. That would have still made it 3 hours at the groomer. If you want your pet to suffer for long periods of time, take them to Groomer London. Let’s not forget the receptionist’s attitude when I did go pick her up. Instead of APOLOGISING, she continued to argue with her lies. Completely unacceptable and unbelievable. HORRIBLE SERVICE!!!
Great team. Everything was on time. They even found a way to get my dog to allow his teeth to be cleaned. Recommended.
As usual a great lion cut for my ragdoll cat Isaac. He was very relaxed and looks amazing. Thank you for taking good care of him.
Great Asian Poodle ✂️ cut by Yana!!!
Thank you!

The best salon in London for little ponytails!
Service of the highest standards, attentive staff. I am very happy with the quality and would recommend this salon to anyone!

Another great grooming at Groomers London. Tatyana and her team are the best in London. Their attention to love, detail and care are the best in all of London. They do an amazing job with my Maltipoo Zinovii.
Thank you, Olivia!
Thank you

Our first ever groom and experience with groomers and it won't be our last with this groomer! Excellent communication and reception and 10/10 service and treatment!  My cat not only looked great but he smelt great and they must've used magic for him to have sat still during his lion cut!
Wonderful, kind care for our Maine Coon. He came home looking beautiful.
Great safe place for your little one 🐾 . Highly recommended …

Chefs Kiss! So very pleased to have recently found a warm, welcoming top notch grooming salon. The quality of service is exceptional. Tatiana and the team are kind, caring, attentive, skilled professionals. My dove bug is always calm, happy and looking gorgeous after every visit. Highly recommend Absolute pawfection 🐾🐾🐾🐾🐾 …
Everything is perfect, as always. My dog gets very anxious during grooming sessions, but the team handles it beautifully and goes above and beyond to make sure he feels safe and calm ♥️🙏🏼 …

My cat is 16 and was seriously matted as she can’t groom herself like she used to. I took her to Groomer London and she was so anxious and stressed from just leaving the house and travelling on the bus, she was in a hyper state when I arrived at Groomers, after calming her the staff then made an assessment and informed me the best treatment for Cicero was to be shaved and showered. The process took around 45 minutes and I was there to reassure the cat whilst the groomers went about the work, they were so kind and caring to my cat that she was completely calm and seemed to understand that she was having a makeover, after the shave, shower then blow dry I felt so happy to see my cat looking so clean and tidy. I also brought a 4 month old Pomeranian along and the groomers gave her a wash and blow dry when I asked without any notice on a busy Friday afternoon. I’m so pleased with the quality service and all the staff were experienced in handling both my cat and dog. I’m still delighted 4 days later when I look at my cat who was looking in a sorry state and now looks like a feline princess. I would highly recommend Groomer London.
Thank you!
We love Groomer London, great service and facilities - and Ruby always looks and smells amazing when she leaves. Thank you :)

Absolutely the best. The care is amazing, perfectly cut and brushed to my liking !

(He’s wearing his harness in the photo)
Thanks a lot
Always do a beautiful job with Gaia! Perfect care and she always smells delicious 🐶✨ …

We’re sorry to see a 1-star review, however we’re unable to find any recent client under this name in our booking system.
If you visited us under a different name or booking, please let us know when your appointment was and what the issue was. We always aim to resolve any concerns and would really appreciate the chance to understand what happened.
Please feel free to contact us directly so we can look into this for you.

My Maltipoo puppy is almost 11 months old now and she’s been coming here ever since she was 3 months old. She’s not the easiest of dogs, she’s full of energy, doesn’t stop moving and known to be a little drama queen but the groomers here are nothing but patient with her. They take their time with her and always ensure the highest of safety as she moves around so much. I bring her here once a month and wouldn’t go anywhere else! Thank you for always looking after Bear! (And I can’t not mention that she always leaves with the most perfect teddy bear haircut).
Great service and excellent grooming. Highly recommend
Thank you, we love Giggles!

We’ve been trusting our dogs’ grooming exclusively to this salon and to Tatiana for several years now. The quality of work is consistently excellent, and what matters most to us is that our dogs are always calm and stress-free during and after their appointments. Truly professional, caring, and attentive service — highly recommended.

We have been loyal clients of Groomer London for over 3 years, and I can honestly say I’ve never come across a better salon. The level of service, quality, and genuine care are all absolutely top-notch.
Our little Maltipoo, Messi, is always happy there -  he loves socialising with other dogs and is welcomed with so much love and attention. It truly feels like a second home for him.
Huge thanks to the salon owner, Tetiana, for creating such a warm, professional, and loving place that we are always happy to come back to again and again. Highly recommended!
Very wonderful place for pet care, everyone  who work there is a professional! 👌🏻🥰 …
The best grooming service in London. Amazing communication, huge variety of dog products, always precise and attentive❤️

Amazing groomers! I’ve not been back for awhile due to moving out of London but now that I’m closer I’ll definitely be back. Tatiana did an amazing job with my little Pomeranian. The best by far 🥰👌🏼 …

Fantastic service. Tanya and Miroslav are the only people whom I would entrust my Pomeranian with. He is very sensitive, with anger issues, and special grooming needs. He comes out happy and gorgeous out of there every time. I cannot recommend this place enough. Thanks for looking after Mazepa ❤️❤️we are so lucky to have found a place that loves animals as much as we do
Thank you!

The most welcoming and top-quality grooming salon in the city. My dogs actually sleep while being groomed — amazing experience. The owner and her daughter at the front desk are wonderful. Worth 100 stars.
I have been using Tatyana grooming services for sometimes .she is very professional,knows her job well and always does an excellent job.I highly recommend her services
A great team of highly professional people !!!

The best groomers in London - they genuinely love and care for all the animals who visit them. My two Pomeranians are so well looked after and come out fluffy and perfect every time, and so happy! They also really know how to care for Pomeranian coats which is an specialised and rare skill. I wouldn’t trust my dogs with anyone else.
The best grooming in the UK !

Amazing dog groomer. Very professional, gentle, and caring. My dog looks perfect and was calm and happy after the visit. Clean place, great attention to detail, and excellent service. Highly recommend
Amazing place, great people. Can’t believe those fake reviews! Everyone is really professional, place is clean and safe. Love you guys 🤍 …

I couldn’t be happier with this groomer! From the moment we walk in, I can tell my dog is comfortable and well cared for. The staff is incredibly kind, patient, and clearly loves what they do. My dog always comes home looking amazing, smelling great! They take the time to listen to exactly what I want and consistently deliver. It’s such a relief knowing my dog is in such good hands. I wouldn’t trust anyone else!
The best salon for dogs and cats! Caring treatment, perfect haircuts, and a very warm atmosphere. The dog is calm and happy—that's the best indicator! We've been coming back for almost two years now.

We’ve been trusting Groomer London for over a year now, and the service is always perfect! The staff are incredibly lovely, and there’s a great selection of products to buy. Our dog always comes out looking (and smelling) amazing — couldn’t recommend them more!
This is an amazing salon! All three of my dogs get groomed here, and they are absolutely happy every time. We always receive top-notch service. I highly recommend it!
A very good salon with professional groomers. And always a very friendly atmosphere😍 …
Brilliant service and the best groomer in London
Warm, welcoming, caring and most of all honest and knows what they are doing. Prices are reasonable too. Absolutely, recommended.

"Excellent grooming salon! Our cocker spaniel got a fantastic haircut—they carefully trimmed his ears and paws. He felt calm, and the groomers were clearly caring and professional. We are very happy with the results and will definitely be back!" ♥️♥️♥️♥️

A very lovely place for dog grooming in London. We’ve been here two times already, and each time we were very happy with the results. The staff is attentive, caring, and great with dogs. Even if small mistakes happen, they are always ready to fix them and make things right. Highly recommended!
Simply the best!

I have a lot of experience with groomers and have very high requirements for dog grooming. I came to Tatiana by recommendation. To say - I wish I personally had such an attentive and professional hairdresser as a groomer for my dogs!
Such attentiveness to the smallest details I have never met ! And as much love, attention and patience as Tatiana shows to my dogs during grooming I could not imagine !
The atmosphere in the salon is absolutely incredible, you don't want to leave ;) cleanliness is incredible! The highest quality standards in everything ! I highly recommend to everyone, after a visit to Tatiana your dog and you will be happy !

Original review below, response as follows;

No this review is not in error but accurate. I visited on 24/05/2025 you will have it on your system. I can also provide a bank statement as proof. You took the FULL payment and only AFTER as I was leaving was I informed the service wasn't fully carried out.

________________________________________________________

Zero stars. I brought my cat for a full grooming- paid £120 and all that was done was he was washed (water only) and 2 nails cut. They did not shampoo him, dry him, clean his ears, teeth and cut all nails. It is common knowledge that cats don't like water, I've taken him to other groomers many times and they get the job done with a bit of patience. This place did not, they stopped after a few moments, refused to do anything further as he was fidgeting and still charged full price. I also wasn't informed of all of this until as I was leaving I checked on him and saw his nails weren't cut and he was still soaking wet, that's when I was informed nothing was complete. Complete lack of communication and professionalism.
Thank you Polina!
Great service, very decent people and the professional team team dealt with my shy timid chihuahua in a great manner when grooming him. Highly.recommend this place.

I was introduced to this grooming salon by a friend. At first, due to their booking policy, I decided not to go and even left a comment about it. However, after my friends insisted, I decided to give them a chance and booked an appointment.

Despite feeling a bit stressed and unsure about the quality of their service, I entrusted my dog to them. From the moment we arrived, they greeted us warmly with smiles, and throughout the entire process, they asked about my preferences and paid attention to every detail. The result exceeded my expectations, and I can confidently say I have found my dog’s new trusted groomer.

Having recently moved to London, this was my first grooming experience here and the first time in three years that I changed my dog’s groomer. Their professional approach, friendly atmosphere, and excellent quality of service make me highly recommend this place to all dog owners, especially those who are very particular about their pets.
thank you!
thank you!

I couldn’t be happier with the service provided for my dog, Luka! From the moment we arrived, the staff were warm, welcoming, and made Luka feel completely at ease. The grooming was done with such care and attention to detail, neatly trimmed, and he smells amazing. You can tell they truly love what they do and treat every dog like their own. Luka left looking like a show dog and wagging his tail the whole way home. Highly recommend to anyone who wants their pup in the best hands possible!

I want to recommend you and your dogs the best grooming salon in London -groomer_london.
Every time we come to London with our two poodles we visit this particular grooming salon. Very attentive, friendly staff, professional and empathetic grooming. I will definitely always trust my little dogs to this salon.
thank you

The best place for me and my dog for so long time!
Everytime so chic and fresh ❤️‍🔥 …
Friendly, welcoming and professional salon
My dog Einstein enjoyed his pamper and he will be back again soon 🐶 …

Such an amazing groomers for cats!

Finding a good cat groomer is hard, and I had a bad experience last year with a mobile groomer, as my cat is quite difficult.

I found Groomer London and brought my cat here as he was matted (he doesn’t let us comb him).

Despite being difficult, they groomed him so quickly, within 30-45 mins all his mattes were gone, they did a nail trim, ear clean, deshedded him & trimmed his long paw fur too.

The lady I spoke to was so lovely and I could tell she genuinely cared for him and knew how to work with cats (unlike most dog grooming salons who just say they can groom cats but don’t actually have the expertise).

Such a lovely service, they did an amazing job. Very efficient and a really clean, nice salon, they even have a separate area downstairs for cats, away from the dogs. Will definitely be coming back!

I’ve been bringing my cat, Sasha, here for almost a year now and I’ve always been so pleased with their service. They give him a full wash and brush, including removing the undercoat, and nail trim. Tatiana and Julia are so gentle with Sasha and he behaves even better with them than he does with me. I would recommend them to anyone with a long-haired cat!

Excellent friendly and caring service! The team did a wonderful job on my 15 year old Norwich Terrier who suffers from arthritis and poor sight so, is quite nervous and a bit snappy. They have a caring and professional approach and looked after him brilliantly.

The team is very capable and professional. We've been there about 3 times already and will continue to go. We had bad experiences with other groomers in the area and our dog was traumatized - more specifically with Verve and Yuppy Puppies, avoid those two if you care for your dog - and the quality of the overall service, in particular in taking care of our dog and making the whole process less stressful for him. Last, but not least, the fact they are transparent and that we can see the dogs being groomed, is a big plus.

Absolutely love this grooming salon!
I bring my two Maltese here and every time they come out looking like little superstars! Tanya is simply the best — so gentle, caring, and talented. She knows exactly how to make my pups feel comfortable and look amazing. The salon is always clean, calm, and welcoming, which makes a big difference. I trust her completely and wouldn’t go anywhere else. Highly recommend — Tanya is a gem!

I had a wonderful experience at this grooming salon in central London. The staff are incredibly skilled and clearly care about the pets they work with. The space is clean, cozy, and welcoming, which made both me and my pet feel at ease. Appointments run smoothly and on time, which I really appreciate. I highly recommend this place to any pet owner looking for professional and friendly service.

We booked an appt last minute while traveling in London (usually we go to the groomers in the US) Julia did an amazing job with Maple’s groom! We walked in and immediately Maple was met with love and pets. We were able to make a same week appointment and she was in and out within 2.5 hours. Julia followed exact instructions and the whole team made sure Maple was having a fun day at the spa! Maple normally doesn’t like the groomers and she was very calm the whole time

Great experience! The staff was kind and took their time to make sure my dog was comfortable. He came back looking clean and well-groomed without being overly perfumed or stressed out. You can tell they actually care about the animals. Will definitely be coming back.

Highly recommend. Our toy poodle has been going here since his very first puppy cut and he comes out looking perfect and happy every time. Everyone who works there is lovely and incredibly helpful. They clearly adore dogs and are very skilled groomers.

This place feels odd to me. I was welcomed by the so called, "Receptionist" with a barrage of judgemental comments which made me feel really uncomfortable and upset. I don't trust them, it feels like a dark place to me. Would not return. Also, don't trust that there is no Trust Pilot account for them, only unverified sources. Wish I had spotted that before going!
Thanks Julia for fantastic work grooming my puppy! I couldn’t be more pleased with his new look 🥰👏 …
Amazing salon!
Amazing and friendly place to bring dog into. Absolute service and good prices.
I loved Groom's barbershop, the service and the very clean haircuts. I will definitely return to the barbershop; I really liked the service.
Love this place 🎈❤️ …

My cat's first grooming experience was fantastic at Groomer London. I highly recommend this place due to its amazing staff. It was a pleasure speaking with the owner, who explained everything to me as a first-time pet owner.
Wonderful people great first experience was great defo booking again ,my dog was super happy coming out totally relaxed
Very experienced groomers who know what they are doing and seem to love their job! Excellent service
They don't pay attention the explicit instructions of what you want your dog to look. Don't go to this place if you have an specific idea of hair cut.
Such lovely people and do my poodle Benny just peaches.
Thank you, Scott.
The services are great. The team is clearly passionate about animals.
Everyone is incredibly friendly and professional especially the blonde woman at reception. I think I found my go-to groomer.
Love it! The best grooming that ee ever had

It’s my first time trying this grooming shop and the experience I had was shocking.
I walked in one week ago to book a cat grooming service for today. At the time of booking, I asked the lady at the reception about what’s included in the grooming and if teeth cleaning is included. She told me that teeth cleaning is extra therefore I booked for both. Today when I took my cat to the shop, a different staff is telling me that they don’t provide teeth cleaning services to cats at all. I was going to accept it and proceed with the grooming initially. However, she goes on saying that I need to pay £50 now as if my cat is being aggressive they will stop the grooming immediately and ask me to pick him up, the £50 will be the fee holding the slot and is non refundable. I explained my cat is very gentle and not aggressive. Also I was not made aware of this rule when I made the booking. She said forcefully to me that I need to pay it now given they couldn’t get hold of me on the phone last week?! This is utterly rude, illogical and not true given I came to the shop in person last week.
I walked away as I cannot trust these people with my cat.

[response to owner's reply below] 1. I was very clear in my review that I walked into your shop in person twice - once to make the appointment and once to attend the appointment I made. I didn't use your service because I was not treated right by your staff (hence the review). 2. As a pet groomer, you should be able to handle the pets and all kind of situations e.g. hiring competent staff, buy suitable equipments or buy insurance for your employees instead of bullying customers. This should not be the reason for deposit. 3. In any case if you do have a deposit policy for no show or time related reasons, please say it at the time of booking. If your staff forgot to mention it, it's YOUR mistake instead of mine. Not to mention that I actually spent my time and made effort to come to your shop, which turns out to be a completely waste.

The best dog groomer ever!
My dog had plenty of cuddles whilst being expertly groomed and behaved himself like I’ve never seen before.  Plus he now looks so handsome and happy🐶❤️ …
thank you!
We are so happy with the grooming for our baby dog/daughter Molly 🐾. We have discovered this grooming salon, on Instagram, and we shared what we would love to have and they did an amazing job. …
A truly beautiful, warm and professional team. Very happy with the service and will be definitely using from now on. 1 happy handsome dog and 1 happy owner!
